presence_rationale: Substantive 'Financial Wellbeing' / 'Indigenous customer support' / 'Financial education' sections. Yuri Ingkarninthi Indigenous Connection contact centre extended to all Westpac Group brand customers. Westpac Scholars Trust 100 scholarships/year. Davidson Institute financial education platform.
specificity_rationale: Names Yuri Ingkarninthi Indigenous Connection contact centre (since 2018), Westpac Scholars Trust (100 scholarships/year, milestone of 500th scholarship awarded), Davidson Institute, Recovery Hub, Westpac app for iOS/Android, Smart Search/Look Who's Charging/Drag & Drop Transfers/Spend Snapshot tool, Ruby Connection community for women, First Australians Capital partnership. Pink Elephants Network early-pregnancy-loss leave reform.
quantification_rationale: Reports SASB FN-CB-240a.4 directly: 1,246,198 financial education participants (vs 1,009,232 in 2020 / 619,995 in 2019). 90,000+ Recovery Hub users, 8,200+ Indigenous Yuri Ingkarninthi customers (toward 20,000 by 2023 target), 8,600+ Spend Snapshot users, 56,600 Ruby Connection members. $11.6M diverse supplier spend ($1.6M Indigenous-owned). $4.3M Westpac Scholars in 2021 ($31M cumulative). 81,062 hardship applications. SASB FN-CB-240a.4 fully covered with YoY tracking; 240a.1/.2/.3 partially.
